The company claims its models will give robots a deep understanding of physical reality and fine-grained motor skills. Will training AI on web videos be enough to master physical movement?

draft.instagram_caption:
Embo emerged from stealth with a $110M seed round led by venture firm a16z.

The startup is developing world models for robotics by training AI on massive amounts of internet video. Embo says its models are designed to give robots a deep understanding of physical reality and fine-grained motor skills.

Can training AI on web videos accurately teach robots real-world physics?
